This duality simplifies probabilistic reasoning in GSI by collapsing two distinct notions of measurability into one. When applied to Borel sets, these mappings form the backbone of stochastic modeling in both systems. Failure modes arise when σ-finiteness or completeness is absent, leading to non-equivalence of measurability concepts and breakdown of standard inference procedures.
